subtasks.objective: Restrict the whitelisted POS create_customer endpoint so only users with Customer create permission can create ERPNext Customer records, removing the unconditional permission bypass.
subtasks.acceptance: ury/ury_pos/api.py create_customer rejects users without Customer create permission before inserting, no longer relies on unconditional ignore_permissions=True for customer creation, preserves existing validation and success response for authorized users, and backend checks or tests cover both unauthorized rejection and authorized creation behavior.
